gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads with a big central band and round letters that stay unclosed, drawn with a technical-pen steadiness. Nata Sans against Wallpoet's bold, high-rising lowercase and gaps between letters is where the pair's strongest quality lives: stress in one, none in the other.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-h: Wallpoet leaves daylight showing between its letters. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs follows with terminals pointing outward and a lowercase nearly as high as its capitals, so the display and the plain sans feel like opposites that agree.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic has wide openings on its small letters and a pronounced x-height, giving a clean, modern text line. Wallpoet belongs big and short.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with smooth curves and see-through gaps. Noto Sans Armenian does the quieter job, with its full c, s and z and wide, inviting round letters making the sans-serif feel approachable and professional.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Wallpoet sweeps smoothly around every bend, bold and commanding, with lowercase that rises high. Noto Sans Avestan handles the reading end, its curves leaving their tips unjoined and its pronounced x-height keeping the plain sans modern and clean.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Paper shows through between Wallpoet's letters, a bold, commanding stencil-like touch with smooth curves. And Noto Sans Bengali, with capitals barely above lowercase and distinctly open mouths, would read in a contemporary, professional way over a longer stretch.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-cham: Bold meets open. Noto Sans Cham brings generous entry space to its c shapes and rounded lowercase forms, which makes its quiet sans-serif voice the best foil for Wallpoet's commanding, high-rising letters.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee gives approachable, professional text with a generous band of letters, short stalks above and an e with a wide gap at its terminal. Give it a comfortable size, whatever Wallpoet does.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Clean and contemporary, Noto Sans Cuneiform opens its e instead of closing the eye, and its lowercase swells like inflated glass beads. And Wallpoet's bold, commanding outlines, with paper showing between letters, give that sans-serif something sturdy to lean against.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Approachable and open, Noto Sans Deseret has apertures that aid legibility and a wide-looking lowercase with squat ascenders. Noto Sans Deseret is the soft half of the pair, while Wallpoet's smooth bold curves supply the commanding side.
